verdict.rationale: Runpod documents several programmatic control surfaces. The REST API v1 covers all compute resources. runpodctl creates, starts, stops, and terminates Pods (e.g. `pod create --gpu-id --image`). Two official MCP servers manage Pods and endpoints through the REST API, and agent skills let a coding agent create Pods and deploy code without the console. Workloads can run from a custom container image set at create time or over SSH, and the GraphQL API and CLI support querying Pods and diagnosing issues. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of monitoring (metrics, logs, status polling) for agents, any independent or hands-on corroboration of a full agent-driven end-to-end lifecycle, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
